headline: Batch 12: six more arcade titles learn to replay
lede: Seedpin rollout batch 12 merged to main: RallyCoDriver, Britannia and IronRing now carry their seed in every filed report and replay the exact same world from ?seed=N, while MarioKart, Prince of Persia and MomentumRunner join the honest-seedless club — fixed worlds pinpointed by tick, score and outcome.

notes.text: Seed+pin 40→43 titles, seedless reporters 18→21; feedbackcheck grew 6 new laws (223 green) and both mutants proven red before merge.

Two premise corrections found by reading the code first: Britannia turned out to be fully seeded (fresh(seed) picks the gate, weather and every ambient hash), while MomentumRunner's contract seed was inert — so it got an honest seedless report instead of a fake pin.

~12 arcade titles remain on #1473, all pure-RNG classic ports (Asteroids, Defender, Pac-Man, Frogger, Rogue…) that need real seed-param surgery; Rogue's 3 random lines are next up. Box Chrome is still broken (#737), so the static+Node tiers carry verification.
